# iru_custom_app (Data Source)

Reads one exact Custom App Library Item configuration through GET only. Returns observed installation settings, exact scripts and optional metadata without resource defaults or write constraints. Missing/null core fields fail; optional missing/null values remain null. Does not expose signed URLs/upload credentials or download, upload, assign, activate, install or execute anything. The single-object endpoint is not paginated.

Reads observed installer settings, exact scripts and optional Self Service and
key/hash/size metadata for one Library Item UUID. Scripts and installer keys are
sensitive and remain in state. Signed URLs, credentials and installer binaries
are excluded. Reported hashes/keys do not prove availability or integrity, and
the lookup does not expose Liftoff timing or every UI option.

See [configuration lookup behavior](../guides/configuration-lookups.md) for
selection, errors, nulls and sensitive state handling.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with an existing Custom App Library Item UUID.
data "iru_custom_app" "selected" {
  library_item_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-000000000094"
}

output "app_name" {
  value = data.iru_custom_app.selected.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `library_item_id` (String) Exact existing Custom App Library Item UUID. Names and partial IDs are not accepted.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports this Library Item as active. Reading never activates it.
- `audit_script` (String, Sensitive) Exact audit-script bytes returned by Iru. Sensitive in displays and stored in state.
- `file_key` (String, Sensitive) Reported uploaded installer key. Sensitive in displays because keys can reveal private paths/names; stored in state. Not an installer export or download URL.
- `file_size` (Number) Reported installer size, or null when omitted/null. Zero remains known zero; no binary is downloaded.
- `id` (String) Canonical Custom App UUID.
- `install_enforcement` (String) Observed install_once, continuously_enforce or no_enforcement setting. Reading never enforces installation.
- `install_type` (String) Observed package, zip or image installation type.
- `name` (String) Current Library Item display name.
- `postinstall_script` (String, Sensitive) Exact postinstall-script bytes returned by Iru. Sensitive in displays and stored in state.
- `preinstall_script` (String, Sensitive) Exact preinstall-script bytes returned by Iru. Sensitive in displays and stored in state.
- `restart` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports restart enabled. Reading never restarts a device.
- `self_service_category_id` (String) Reported Self Service category UUID, or null when omitted/null. Preserved while hidden.
- `self_service_recommended` (Boolean) Reported recommendation flag, or null when omitted/null, distinct from false. Preserved while hidden.
- `sha256` (String) Reported installer SHA256, or null when omitted/null. Never computed from the key or treated as verification of downloaded bytes.
- `show_in_self_service` (Boolean) Observed Self Service visibility, or null when omitted/null, distinct from false.
- `unzip_location` (String) Observed extraction location, or null when omitted/null. Empty remains empty.
